notes: New: Find on the web. Tell Amani what you want to learn and she searches for articles, YouTube lessons and PDFs, tells you which are worth your time, and lets you pick.
Pick several and Amani merges them into one course, ordered by topic, with every part marked with its source number.
Search uses your Gemini key when you have one. You can also add a free Brave or Tavily key in the search settings.
If a source cannot be read, the others still go into your course and Knowvia tells you which one failed and why.
